_meta.purpose: User-facing Chinese for the dsh-autorestart rescue kit.
_meta.encoding: UTF-8 WITHOUT a byte order mark. The .ps1 files next to this one are pure ASCII, so this is the only place a non-ASCII byte may live. A BOM here would break JSON.parse.
_meta.placeholders: Values may contain {0}, {1} ... placeholders that the scripts fill in with -f formatting.
_meta.fallback: Every key has an English fallback inside the .ps1. If this file is missing or broken, the scripts say so in English and keep working in English.
